entry.title: notes on empty states
entry.content:
I keep coming back to empty states, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Empty states shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
